description: Sensores acotados a la lista de `queries/entity_ids_listed.sql` (ver `queries/grafana_entity_ids.sql`). **Vista:** *Un sensor* = una serie + KPIs; *Todos numéricos* = varias series (mismos sensores numéricos que el master), sin KPIs. Rango de fechas arriba a la derecha.

panels.description: **Un sensor:** contactos 0/1, numéricos como en ltss. **Todos numéricos:** superposición de las magnitudes numéricas del proyecto (sin binarios ni forecast texto).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "time" AS "time",
  entity_id AS metric,
  v AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    "time",
    entity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN trim(state) IN ('on', 'off') THEN CASE WHEN trim(state) = 'on' THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END
      WHEN trim(state) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(state)::double precision
      ELSE NULL
    END AS v
  FROM public.ltss
  WHERE state IS NOT NULL
    AND state <> 'unavailable'
    AND $__timeFilter("time")
) AS sub
WHERE v IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (
      '${vista}' = 'numericos'
      AND entity_id IN (
        'sensor.mislata_direccion_viento',
        'sensor.mislata_humedad',
        'sensor.mislata_nubosidad',
        'sensor.mislata_presion',
        'sensor.mislata_temperatura',
        'sensor.mislata_viento',
        'sensor.sensor_temperatura_4_humidity',
        'sensor.sensor_temperatura_4_pressure',
        'sensor.sensor_temperatura_4_temperature',
        'sensor.sun_solar_azimuth',
        'sensor.sun_solar_elevation'
      )
    )
    OR ('${vista}' = 'uno' AND entity_id = '${sensor}')
  )
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT NOW() AS "time", AVG(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN trim(state) IN ('on', 'off') THEN CASE WHEN trim(state) = 'on' THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END
    WHEN trim(state) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(state)::double precision
    ELSE NULL
  END AS v
  FROM public.ltss
  WHERE entity_id = '${sensor}'
    AND state IS NOT NULL
    AND state <> 'unavailable'
    AND $__timeFilter("time")
) sub
WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND '${vista}' = 'uno'

SELECT "time" AS "time", v AS value FROM (
  SELECT "time",
    CASE
      WHEN trim(state) IN ('on', 'off') THEN CASE WHEN trim(state) = 'on' THEN 1::double precision ELSE 0::double precision END
      WHEN trim(state) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(state)::double precision
      ELSE NULL
    END AS v
  FROM public.ltss
  WHERE entity_id = '${sensor}'
    AND state IS NOT NULL
    AND state <> 'unavailable'
    AND $__timeFilter("time")
    AND '${vista}' = 'uno'
) x
WHERE v IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "time" DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.description: Lecturas con valor numérico o on/off en el rango.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS "time", COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM public.ltss
WHERE entity_id = '${sensor}'
  AND state IS NOT NULL
  AND state <> 'unavailable'
  AND $__timeFilter("time")
  AND '${vista}' = 'uno'
  AND (
    trim(state) IN ('on', 'off')
    OR trim(state) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
  )
